headline: Shivalik Bimetal Controls submits investor presentation to NSE
hook: Routine investor deck released by Shivalik Bimetal
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited has submitted an official investor presentation to the stock exchange. The filing contains routine corporate and operational updates shared with shareholders and analysts. No specific financial results, major capital actions, or strategic changes were disclosed in the headline announcement. Retail investors can review the presentation for updated company guidance and operational metrics.
why_it_matters: Updated corporate metrics available for review.

headline: Shivalik Bimetal Controls declares Rs 2 interim dividend
hook: Second interim payout announced for holders
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited announced an interim dividend of Rs 2 per equity share following its board meeting on November 4, 2026. The payout rewards existing shareholders as part of the company's capital return strategy. Retail investors holding the stock on the record date will receive the cash dividend directly.
whats_next: Record date announcement for the interim dividend
why_it_matters: Cash payout credited directly to eligible shareholders.

headline: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Board Approves 2:1 Bonus Issue
hook: Two extra shares for every one held
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited announced that its board of directors approved a bonus issue of shares in the ratio of 2:1 on November 4, 2026. This means shareholders will receive two additional equity shares for every single equity share held as of the yet-to-be-announced record date. Bonus issues increase the total number of outstanding shares while lowering the individual share price proportionally. Retail investors holding the stock will see their share count triple without any direct cash outflow.
whats_next: Record date announcement for the bonus issue
why_it_matters: Your shareholding triples, while the stock price adjusts downwards proportionally.
winners_losers: Existing shareholders gain / New buyers unaffected

headline: Shivalik Bimetal Controls releases financial results for the quarter ended September 2026
hook: September quarter numbers arrive at Shivalik Bimetal
summary: Shivalik Bimetal Controls Limited has submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchanges. These results detail the company's financial performance, revenue, and profitability over the preceding quarter. Retail investors can review these filings to assess the operational health and margin trends of the company. The numbers provide direct insight into the company's ongoing performance within its industrial segment.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal current margins for your Shivalik Bimetal holdings
